apps/api/src/db/client.ts.reason: closeDatabase() ends the pool, which only the command-line scripts do: a test that ended it would end it for every test in its worker.

apps/api/src/db/migrate.ts.reason: Its command-line part, and the two failures the suite's own database cannot have: no Postgres at all, and no pg_stat_statements. runMigrations() itself runs for every worker.

apps/api/src/env.ts.reason: Read once, when the process starts. Its two refusals, of a test run with no TEST_DATABASE_URL and of an invalid environment, cannot be reached from a process that started with a valid one.

apps/api/src/mcp/token.ts.reason: The one function no test runs logs a failure to record when a token was last used: only a database that refuses the write reaches it, and no test here fakes one.
